description: IOI clean baseline (Wang et al. 2023, arXiv:2211.00593): mean logit(IO) - logit(S) at END over the clean IOI distribution. Golden: paper reports 3.56 on 100k examples (band +/-1.2 from the VeriFires ioi-circuit checklist); the IO-over-S rate follows post-hoc as the fraction of positive per-row values.
